content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BSPHCL Manager(HR) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the BSPHCL recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the BSPHCL recruitment is Manager(HR) on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by BSPHCL?
faq.answer: BSPHCL has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Manager(HR).

faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.answer: The walk-in date for the Manager(HR) post is 10th September 2026.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Manager(HR) post is 62 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Manager(HR) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Last Pay minus pension, with additional benefits as per Pay Level-12 entitlements.

faq.answer: A minimum of 20 years of experience in Human Resource/ Establishment/ Personnel Administration is required.

faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original certificates/testimonials along with one set of photo copies.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at the BSPHCL office in Patna, Bihar.
